purpose: Separately fitted DEBM (repaired) and CONCORD (invariant_min) with within-diagnosis permutation when one group's sequence differs by one event moved 6 positions (K6_SINGLE_*), six disjoint adjacent swaps (K6_DISJOINT_*) or one event moved 13 positions (K13_SINGLE_*). K13_SINGLE_E4 and K6_DISJOINT_E2 provide the datasets and the CONCORD results of two paired-benchmark conditions (Fig. 3c,d; Supplementary Table 2); the other cells are not used in the paper.
